description: Attach individually trackable child tasks to an existing instruction using the parent task ID and version.

executionId.description: Execution record.id from begin_agent_execution when associating this call with an existing execution; not a session or project ID.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reuse the same key and identical payload only to retry the same mutation; use a new key for a new action.

parentTaskId.description: Existing instruction task that owns the queued child tasks.

parentVersion.description: Version of the parent instruction used when queueing tasks.

projectId.description: Owned project ID returned by list_linked_projects or map_project; do not use a local path or repository URL.

sessionId.description: Active session record.id from start_agent_session for this project. Pass it on later project calls after starting the session.

tasks.description: Individual work items to queue under this instruction.

name: queue_instruction_tasks
title: Queue instruction tasks
